source: Measured with scripts/dobAblation.mjs and scripts/dobTradeDiff.mjs at commit 6577e486 (removed afterwards; restore with git show 6577e486:scripts/<name>). node scripts/dobAblation.mjs on .debug/dob-winrate cached XAUUSD candles 2026-10-01..2026-11-14, 0 requests; baseline report-v6-final
decision: Default W1: nearTouch none + bridgeClosures false. Best non-replica variant over Feb-Nov (a +121 R vs v6 +125, b +26 vs +27), not better than v6 by the criterion (5/10 months on route a). Near-touch on OB2 cost route a 53 R over ten months; the Oct/Nov preference for V2 did not hold. Shipped as v7 default; ablation-only switches (maxRetestDepth, stopRule, trace) removed from the product code after this measurement.

tradeDiffV6vsC4.closureFinding: All 39 C4-only trades span an XAU market closure between OB1 and the pair (27 daily, 12 weekend); W4 = C4 without bridging reproduces v6 route a exactly.

longHistory.baseline: v6 via local copy (= T1 report-v6-long: 961 pairs, a +125 R, b +27 R)
longHistory.note: V1,V2,C3,C4 with bridgeClosures=true (T2c state); D = previous default (nearTouch second, no bridging); W1 = nearTouch none, no bridging (new default); W4 = v6 replica without bridging, identical to v6 on route a.
